title: Fe realProxik gui
script:
-- local service
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local lplr = Players.LocalPlayer

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", lplr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
ScreenGui.Name = "RealProxik_Ultra"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 450)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -225)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true -- Legacy draggable for quick use

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame)
local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MainFrame)
UIStroke.Thickness = 2
UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", MainFrame)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
Title.Text = "REALPROXIK v1.0"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 0)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 22

local Scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", MainFrame)
Scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, -55)
Scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 50)
Scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 3, 0)
Scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4

local Layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", Scroll)
Layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
Layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

local function AddBtn(text, color, func)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton", Scroll)
	b.Size = UDim2.new(0.95, 0, 0, 35)
	b.Text = text
	b.BackgroundColor3 = color
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
	b.TextSize = 14
	Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
	b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(func)
end

AddBtn("DECAL ALL (104537801359266)", Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 0), function()
	local id = "rbxassetid://104537801359266"
	for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
				local d = Instance.new("Decal", v)
				d.Texture = id
				d.Face = face
			end
		end
	end
end)

AddBtn("SKYBOX (104537801359266)", Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 80), function()
	local s = Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)
	local id = "rbxassetid://104537801359266"
	s.SkyboxBk, s.SkyboxDn, s.SkyboxFt, s.SkyboxLf, s.SkyboxRt, s.SkyboxUp = id, id, id, id, id, id
end)

AddBtn("FLING PARTICLES", Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 120), function()
	local char = lplr.Character
	if char then
		local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", char.HumanoidRootPart)
		p.Texture = "rbxassetid://108171234284952"
		p.Speed = NumberRange.new(60)
		p.VelocitySpread = 360
	end
end)

AddBtn("HINT", Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), function()
	local h = Instance.new("Hint", workspace)
	h.Text = "realProxik has been Haxxored this game."
	Debris:AddItem(h, 5)
end)

AddBtn("MSG", Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), function()
	local m = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
	m.Text = "realProxik is back 666 666 666"
	Debris:AddItem(m, 5)
end)

AddBtn("DISCO ", Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 0), function()
	spawn(function()
		for i = 1, 100 do
			Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 1, 1, 1)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end)

AddBtn("FLOOD MAP", Color3.fromRGB(0, 80, 200), function()
	local w = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
	w.Size, w.Anchored, w.Transparency, w.CanCollide = Vector3.new(5000, 1, 5000), true, 0.5, false
	w.Color = Color3.new(0, 0.4, 0.8)
	spawn(function()
		while w.Parent do w.Position += Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0) task.wait() end
	end)
end)

AddBtn("AVATAR: REALPROXIK", Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 150), function()
	lplr.Character.Humanoid:ApplyDescription(Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(8567309898))
end)

AddBtn("BIG ALL (LOCAL)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 0), function()
	for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local h = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if h then
			p.Character:ScaleTo(3)
		end
	end
end)

AddBtn("INF YIELD (FE)", Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50), function()
	loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source'))()
end)

AddBtn("JOHN DOE ", Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), function()
	loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Client-Replication-John-doe-up-by-gojohdkaisenkt-34198"))()
end)

AddBtn("JUMPSCARE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), function()
	local j = Instance.new("ImageLabel", ScreenGui)
	j.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
	j.Image = "rbxassetid://91639112255821"
	task.wait(2)
	j:Destroy()
end)
